proposals.title: Honest dissolve help matching no-param ST_Union
proposals.summary: analysis/dissolve.md still documents an optional key field, attributes to preserve, and group-by-style aggregates. dissolveGenerator is Record<string, never>: one ST_Union of every input feature with empty outputSchema (attributes dropped). The derived-layer builder already shows NoParamInfo. Rewrite dissolve.md to match shipped behavior and point authors who need key+aggregates at group-by with geometry strategy dissolve.
proposals.rationale: Highest-visibility analysis help lie left after recipe-sink honesty. Catalog and builder are honest; the help page is not.
proposals.risk: Authors who planned key-field dissolve will feel a downgrade. Prefer clear redirect to group-by rather than silently inventing groupBy on dissolve in this PR.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about what we are not. Prefer documented PostGIS union over fake Esri Dissolve parity.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite dissolve.md Inputs/Output/Examples to no-param union + attribute drop; keep Dissove vs group-by section as the path for keyed dissolve; CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Honest fishnet help matching cellSize / unit / output
proposals.summary: analysis/fishnet.md advertises hex cells, geo-boundary / manual extent pickers, and clip-to-polygon. FishnetParams only expose cellSize, unit, and output polygons|lines; extent comes from the pipeline source bbox. Rewrite help to match the generator and builder.
proposals.rationale: Same class of honesty bug as dissolve. Demo authors reading help will configure options that do not exist.
proposals.risk: Do not invent hex or clip params in this PR. Document square grid over source bbox; note hex / clip as not shipped.
proposals.ethosFit: Docs match the free PostGIS grid you actually get.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite fishnet.md Inputs/Output to cellSize + unit + polygons|lines over source extent; remove hex / geo-boundary / clip claims; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Honest contour help matching TIN iso-lines
proposals.summary: analysis/contour.md documents iso-polygons, smoothing, and per-band aggregates. contourGenerator emits TIN intersection iso-lines with field + auto|manual levels only (level property). Align help with the builder ContourStepEditor.
proposals.rationale: Third analysis help oversell in the same sweep. Contours are advanced; wrong help burns support time.
proposals.risk: Keep auto/manual + interval/levels accurate; explicitly say iso-polygons and smoothing are not options.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest TIN contours on your PostGIS, not a fake Spatial Analyst Contour tool sheet.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite contour.md to field + auto/manual levels, line output with level attribute; drop iso-polygon / smoothing / aggregate claims; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Continue #162 i18n on Analyze Erase and Centroid guides

proposals.risk: Keep SQL / ST_* snippets as-is. Reuse existing analyzeWorkbench keys where Buffer already defined Creating… / Create derived layer.
proposals.ethosFit: Language follow-through on free analysis chrome. No Contour brand kit.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Extract Erase/Centroid guide strings into en/es/fr/de/pt-BR analyzeWorkbench.* catalogs with t() calls; What's new optional (i18n-only can skip).

proposals.title: Guided Dissolve shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: After dissolve help honesty, Analyze still has no Dissolve this layer control. dissolveGenerator is no-param like centroid. Mirror AnalyzeCentroidGuide: POST a single-step dissolve derived_layer, label as server job, warn that attributes are dropped.
proposals.rationale: Cheap Analyze honesty win after Centroid. Esri Dissolve seat pain maps onto free PostGIS ST_Union without inventing groupBy.
proposals.risk: Users may expect key-field dissolve. Label no-param union + attribute drop; point at group-by for keyed dissolve; reuse existing worker path.
proposals.ethosFit: Free-at-point-of-use analysis on your hardware. Guided PostGIS over proprietary Dissolve seats.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-dissolve-guide POSTing single-step dissolve derived_layer; refresh dissolve.md Analyze entry after honesty rewrite; What's new + CHANGELOG.

proposals.title: Guided Simplify shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: simplifyGenerator already takes tolerance + unit (Buffer-shaped). Analyze has no Simplify this layer control. Mirror AnalyzeBufferGuide: short form, POST single-step simplify derived_layer, label as server job.
proposals.rationale: Next parameterized Analyze shortcut after Buffer. Douglas-Peucker on PostGIS without a desktop seat.
proposals.risk: Tolerance unit confusion (degrees vs meters) — reuse Buffer unit conversion honesty and MAX simplify meters already in the generator.
proposals.ethosFit: Free generalize / simplify on your PostGIS. Prefer honest meter units over degree traps.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-simplify-guide + help/analysis/simplify.md; What's new + CHANGELOG.

proposals.title: Honest recipe AOI hint instead of wave 2 promise

proposals.risk: Tiny copy change; no runner work. Do not invent layer AOI support here.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about what we are not. No aspirational wave labels in the authoring UI.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite the AOI parameter hint under osm-features-overlay; CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new.
